Surface

Move the slider to 0 % to remove the ice and see the glacier bed. Bed: swissBEDROCK (swisstopo, 10 m; under glaciers it is the GLAMOS 2020 ice-thickness model, from GPR 1958, 2009 and 2011 with thickness referenced to the 2017 surface). The bed does not change between years; thickness = modelled surface − bed. The bed is least certain far from the radar lines (colour: distance to GPR).

Measurements on top

Shot below the surface = observed lower than modelled. Rejected shots lie far below the surface and are drawn through the terrain.
How to use, and what is shown
Drag to orbit, scroll to zoom, right-drag to pan. Slide through the years below.
2026 is not shown: GLAMOS release 2025 has no 2026 balance and no 2026 survey is used. Years between the two measured anchors (2017, 2023) are interpolated; 2016, 2024 and 2025 are extrapolated.
Hover the surface for elevation and what it rests on. Click a stake or an ICESat-2 shot to pin its details.
